title: TV Remote Ki Roshni Aapko Dikhti Kyun Nahi? 🤔 #shorts
description:
TV remote har baar roshni phenkta hai, par aapki aankhen use dekh hi nahi sakti! Dekhiye remote aur TV asal mein kaise baat karte hain.
💡 Remote ka IR LED infrared roshni chhodta hai, jo aankhon ko nahi dikhti
⚡ Ye roshni ek second mein 38,000 baar timtimati hai
🔢 Har button ka apna alag pulse pattern hota hai, bilkul Morse code jaisa
📺 TV ka receiver dhoop aur bulb ko ignore karke sirf yahi timtimahat padhta hai
📱 Bonus: phone camera se remote dekho, chamak dikh jayegi!
Aisi aur electronics ki asaan explanations ke liye SUBSCRIBE karein! 🔔
